assumptions: Local execution environment and recorded versions are accurate.
limitations: External runtime, security, legal and human qualification remain outside this package.
confidence: high for repository-local exercised evidence; low for external production qualification
independentVerificationStatus: internal role-separated adversarial validation; external certification pending

contradictions.statement: ZIP extraction can remove executable bits while package scripts invoked shell files directly.
contradictions.resolution: All nested shell entry points use explicit interpreters; archives normalize modes and portability tests exercise extraction.

contradictions.statement: Permissive JSON serialization erased undefined and non-finite values, allowing distinct signed inputs to collapse.
contradictions.resolution: Strict canonical signed-material validation rejects ambiguous values and byte hashing uses an explicit domain API.

contradictions.statement: Replay protection held only in memory and disappeared after restart.
contradictions.resolution: FileReplayLedger provides atomic, privacy-preserving single-consumption across restart and concurrent local processes.

contradictions.statement: Telemetry retention/cardinality were unbounded and degraded dependencies could be reported ready.
contradictions.resolution: Bounded retention, cardinality, attribute allowlists, digest binding and blocked/degraded readiness rules are enforced.

contradictions.statement: The standalone proof omitted the private-server requirements lock used by configuration validation.
contradictions.resolution: The lock is packaged and archive tests require all release-critical inputs.

contradictions.statement: The stability wrapper could wait on inherited output handles after the authoritative runner had emitted complete TAP.
contradictions.resolution: Stability evidence is captured from isolated complete runs with process-group cleanup; validator treats incomplete wrapper output as non-success.

contradictions.statement: Two runtime modules imported each other, contradicting the intended layered architecture.
contradictions.resolution: Shared type contracts were extracted; architecture validation now proves zero source cycles.

contradictions.statement: The engineering assistant trusted its model dependency to enforce signature, proposal-only status and tool semantics.
contradictions.resolution: The assistant independently verifies the signed receipt, authority ceiling and change-tool contract; malicious dependency substitutions are tested and mutated.

contradictions.statement: An unavailable npm advisory endpoint was previously interpreted as zero vulnerabilities.
contradictions.resolution: Advisory parsing now distinguishes passed, failed and environment-blocked; unavailable metadata can never become a zero-vulnerability claim.

contradictions.statement: Coverage percentages could be green while architecture paths, design references or external blockers remained open.
contradictions.resolution: Coverage is now combined with architecture closure, Design-to-Evidence, invariant, mutation, recovery, browser, isolation and qualification gates.

contradictions.claim: Agent sensitive-target protection covered dependency lockfiles.
contradictions.contradiction: The prior compound condition could permit package-lock.json when allowedFiles contained no other sensitive path.
contradictions.resolution: Replaced compound condition with direct fileIsSensitive(targetFile) rejection and added adversarial plus mutation coverage.

contradictions.statement: The v32 handoff required root authority documents that were absent from the portable workspace.
contradictions.resolution: v32.1 restores CLAUDE.md, MASTER_DIRECTIVE.md and PROGRAM_CHARTER.md and validates them as release-blocking continuity inputs.

contradictions.statement: The prior workspace named six external blockers but had no executable acceptance contracts for their evidence.
contradictions.resolution: Added six fail-closed evaluators, one aggregate gate, a schema, manifest, runbook and deterministic ingestion script.

contradictions.statement: Three modules exceeded the v32.2 complexity warning budget.
contradictions.resolution: Separated contracts, compatibility types and transition policy; the production-source complexity scan now has zero warnings and zero blocks.

contradictions.statement: Type-only imports introduced apparent architecture cycles during refactoring.
contradictions.resolution: Moved shared types into directionally neutral modules and restored zero source cycles.

contradictions.statement: The request to raise every metric conflicts with the prohibition on claiming unexecuted external and human outcomes.
contradictions.resolution: All fourteen metrics improve through local mechanisms and readiness evidence, while product and external scores remain below production floors and blockers remain active.

contradictions.statement: Increasing test count can appear to increase confidence while retaining one correlated oracle.
contradictions.resolution: Proof diversity is scored separately from count and requires distinct techniques, oracles, environments and defect classes.

contradictions.statement: Adding famous security tools can appear to improve assurance while actually expanding the trusted computing base.
contradictions.resolution: No tool is vendored or run automatically; only narrow evidence adapters are implemented and external executions remain NOT_EXECUTED.

contradictions.statement: Adding a broad CNCF stack can increase cost and trusted computing base instead of reducing them.
contradictions.resolution: Use Dapr only as a replaceable contract profile, admit narrow components independently, pin versions, measure consolidation, and keep actual runtimes external until qualified.

contradictions.claim: Cost reduction permits dropping error security or slow traces.
contradictions.resolution: False. Mandatory trace classes are retained and over-budget state is explicit.

contradictions.statement: A signed outgoing-coordinator relinquishment is always available during recovery.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.35 permits takeover only after verified lease expiry plus safety delay and witness quorum, then permanently fences the lost coordinator.

contradictions.claim: HTTPS alone proves external independence.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.36 requires signed host evidence and auditor quorum; local pinned HTTPS remains local-only.

contradictions.claim: A signed evidence bundle can be trusted without checking the files themselves.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.37 requires an exact inventory and hashes the bytes read from the filesystem; missing, extra or changed files fail closed.

contradictions.claim: A lifecycle authority signature on a certificate is sufficient evidence that key rotation was properly authorized.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.38 independently verifies the original proposal, current/replacement key-possession statements, separated security approvals and the certificate binding before accepting the lifecycle chain.

contradictions.claim: A field declaring HSM custody or a signed threshold certificate alone proves non-extractable external custody and safe recovery.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.39 independently verifies provider attestation, key and request binding, three-of-five approvals, predecessor continuity, monitor retrieval, revocation propagation and exact site-recovery bytes before accepting the local-only verdict.

contradictions.claim: Naming an adapter PKCS#11 or remote attestation proves multi-provider external HSM interoperability.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.40 verifies exact module bytes, interface and conformance metadata, authority signatures, original attestation and challenge bytes, provider diversity, threshold evidence, monitor receipts and exact recovery bytes before accepting even a local-only verdict.

contradictions.claim: A provider name, root fingerprint or conformance PASS label is sufficient evidence for external HSM onboarding and safe replacement.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.41 reverifies signed root, module and attestation bytes, exact device-session conformance, monotonic revocation, three-custodian replacement, durable checkpoint retrieval and exact recovery before accepting even a local-only verdict.

contradictions.claim: A successful build using externally injected TypeScript proves reproducible installation.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.42 requires lockfile-bound capsule tarballs and npm ci offline from an empty cache before the build receipt is accepted.

contradictions.claim: A signed vulnerability advisory alone is sufficient to replace a dependency capsule.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.43 also requires exact provenance targeting, independent revocation quorum, verified rollback, independent replacement provenance and a new offline installation receipt.

contradictions.claim: A policy-eligible dependency candidate may be promoted after compatibility tests alone.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.44 also requires three independent approvals, a signed bounded canary, threshold evaluation, automatic rollback and a retention ledger.

contradictions.claim: A successful single-package canary proves that a coupled multi-package update is safe.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.45 requires an atomic transaction manifest, exact dependency conflict resolution, staged canary evidence for the full package set, rollback classification and interrupted-update recovery.

contradictions.claim: A replacement coordinator may safely resume from the last visible state without a durable journal or fencing token.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.46 requires a durably fsynced contiguous journal, three-witness expired-lease takeover and exact fencing authority for every resumed entry.

contradictions.claim: Three local process replicas are sufficient evidence of externally independent coordinator and journal operation.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.47 distinguishes local multi-process durability from external topology and requires trusted external evidence before setting externalTopologyObserved true.

contradictions.claim: A signed deployment manifest proves external execution.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.48 separates readiness from execution and keeps the local proof in rehearsal status until external auditor evidence is imported.

contradictions.claim: Issuing enrollment packages proves an external ceremony occurred.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.49 requires signed role responses, exact transfer bytes and twenty-two independent infrastructure attestations before any external gate can open.

contradictions.claim: Sixteen quarantined local submissions prove an external ceremony is ready.
contradictions.resolution: False. V33.50 requires externally qualified malware scans and exactly twenty-two trusted infrastructure attestations before external readiness can be asserted.

contradictions.claim: Completing the local operations queue proves external readiness.
contradictions.resolution: False. The readiness certificate remains local unless the v33.50 base verdict is external and the final snapshot contains exactly twenty-two trusted attestations.

contradictions.claim: A locally replicated journal proves external operations persistence.
contradictions.resolution: False. All replicas and workers are local rehearsal identities; external topology, humans and attestations remain zero.

contradictions.claim: Multiple local processes prove independent external infrastructure.
contradictions.resolution: False. Process separation is local rehearsal evidence only; external qualification requires trusted external evidence digests and public endpoints.

contradictions.claim: A complete local execution bundle proves external infrastructure qualification.
contradictions.resolution: False. External readiness also requires an externally qualified v33.53 base verdict and trusted external evidence for every role, audit, drill and bundle.

contradictions.claim: Local AES-GCM encryption and offline file copies prove external custody.
contradictions.resolution: False. External status requires an externally verified v33.54 base verdict, independent custodians and trusted external evidence digests.

contradictions.claim: Local replicated files prove externally independent custody authority.
contradictions.resolution: False. External status requires an external v33.55 base verdict and trusted evidence digests for lease, replicas and recovery.
